lines.t: First stalk broken
Earthstart shaken
Grave‑seals broken
Death code wakened
When the sky went black and the veil ripped wide
Graves split open in the quake outside
Hollows in the rock, stone doors undone
Ground still shaking round the crucified One
Third‑day dawn, now the stone rolls back
Firstfruits stepping out on the victory track
Head of the sheaf walks out of the dust
Priest of forever with a body that can’t rust
Feel that sub like the ground when it split
Dead hearts knocking when the bassline hits
Every kick drum echoes through time
From the opened tombs to the end of the line
We are the stalks in the sheaf by His side
Firstfruits rising on a resurrection ride
Priest at the altar with the scars in His hands
Lifting up the bundle from the dust of these lands
Twenty‑four crowns in a circle of flame
Faces on the floor, but they shout one name
Elders on thrones from the sleep of the dead
All around the Firstfruits, the resurrected Head
Bass like thunder, elders in the glow
Crowns in the air when the kick drum blows
Death shut down when the trap hats roll
Life in the Lamb, high voltage in the soul
Cracks in the earth on the day He died
Graves yawning open on every side
But they waited in the dark till the Third‑Day call
When the Firstfruits rose, they came out with them all
Once just dust in forgotten fields
Now white robes where the glory spills
Old bones tuned like a choir in steel
Every pulse syncs to the Priest that heals
Hear that synth like a veil being torn
Deep bass growl like a new world born
Every drop points straight to the Throne
Where the sheaf and the Priest stand alone
We are the stalks in the sheaf by His side
We are the stalks in the sheaf by His side
Firstfruits rising on a resurrection ride
Priest at the altar with the scars in His hands
Lifting up the bundle from the dust of these lands
Twenty‑four crowns in a circle of flame
Faces on the floor, but they shout one name
Elders on thrones from the sleep of the dead
All around the Firstfruits, the resurrected Head
Kick‑drum heartbeat, graveyard hum
Trap‑snare marching where the saints come from
Bassline roaring like an open scroll
Elders in the mix when the thunder rolls
Priest in the center with the keys and the crown
Sub shakes hell as the last wall’s down
Death in the red, system overload
Life peaks hard on the glory road
Wave that sheaf when the bass drops in
Let the whole room feel what it means to win
From the opened graves to the crystal sea
Firstfruits, elders, and the Priest set free
Lights go black but the life still burns
Every single stalk for the King returns
In the final glow when the last beat ends
We rise with the One who calls us friends
